record_type_quote: More precisely, besides aiming to replicate this link, we assumed that altruism also influences hypothetical and actual voting behavior as well as endorsement of specific, currently debated political agendas.

targets.evidence_quote: Taking a similar approach, Zettler and Hilbig (2010) recently suggested that altruism, as conceptualized within the HEXACO model of personality (Ashton & Lee, 2007), is crucial for one’s political orientation. The empirical findings supported this hypothesis, showing that more altruistic individuals placed themselves further left on a simple left–right scale assessing political orientation.
targets.outcome_quote: Replicating previous results, and confirming Hypothesis 1, altruism correlated negatively with political orientation, though comprising a smaller effect size (r = −.25) than reported previously.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Publisher results preview explicitly confirms the central previous finding; a smaller effect is not a mixed result.
